summary: DXT5/BC3-style block decompression. First delegates the colour half of the block to KeyframeQuadInterpolationWithBitPackedSelector(a1, a2+4); if that returns a negative error code the failure is propagated. Otherwise two packed dwords are unpacked into 16 alpha values: the first dword at a2 yields 8 four-bit nibbles written as scaled floats (nibble * 0.06666667) into the float4 alpha slots starting at a1+3 with a 4-float stride, and the second dword at a2+4 yields the remaining 8 nibbles written into the slots starting at a1+35. Returns 0 on success.

local_names.a1: destination pixel buffer treated as float4 (RGBA) entries; only the alpha channel (offset 3 within each entry) is written
local_names.a2: source block data: two 32-bit alpha dwords followed by the colour block read from a2+4
local_names.v3: first packed alpha dword at a2
local_names.v7: second packed alpha dword at a2+4
local_names.v5: walking alpha-slot pointer starting at a1+3 (float4 entry 0)
local_names.v9: walking alpha-slot pointer starting at a1+35 (float4 entry 8)

operations.description: Colour-block decompression: KeyframeQuadInterpolationWithBitPackedSelector(a1, a2+4) processes the colour half; its return value gates the alpha path
On a negative return from the colour decompressor, propagate the error result immediately instead of unpacking alpha

Unpack the first 8 nibbles from the dword at a2: each nibble (v3 & 0xF) is shifted out of the dword and written as float (nibble * 0.06666667) into the alpha slot at a1+3 with a 4-float stride across 8 float4 entries

Unpack the next 8 nibbles from the dword at a2+4: each nibble (v7 & 0xF) is shifted out and written as float (nibble * 0.06666667) into the alpha slot at a1+35 with a 4-float stride across the second 8 float4 entries
Return 0 on the completed alpha unpack path; the colour-decompressor error result is returned on the failure path
